title: Skill Deprioritization: Reorganizing in the Age of Generative Artificial Intelligence
authors: Matteo Devigili; Erdem Dogukan Yilmaz; Vibha Gaba; Henrich R. Greve
eligible_reason: Single common shock. The main treatment did_f = gpt3 x felten_d, where gpt3 = 1 after the ChatGPT release (Nov 2022, common to all firms) and felten_d = time-invariant high GenAI-exposure indicator (Felten AIOE). One adoption cohort; the GPT-4 split (did3_f, did4_f) adds a second common date for the same firms (extra treatment regressor). Main estimator is Poisson PML (ppmlhdfe) with company and month FE, with and without time-varying firm controls (size, roa, leverage, R&D, capex, layoffs); robustness includes CEM, placebo dates, HonestDiD, ETWFE (jwdid) and OLS/negative binomial variants. Not a staggered design and nonlinear; not a near-miss.
design_notes: analysis/stata-scripts/_0-pml.do (main, called by run_stata.py): gen did_f = gpt3 * felten_d; ppmlhdfe y0..y4_b did_f [size roa leverage rd_ta rd_d capex_at layoff_p], a(company t) vce(cluster company); outcomes y0-y4_b are counts of job postings requiring each organizing-skill category (Lightcast). Event study: ppmlhdfe y lead12-lead2 TreatZero lag1-lag11 lead1 controls (monthly around Nov 2022). 1,820 listed US firms, +/-12 months around the shock.
estimators_reported: Poisson PML DiD with common shock (main)
Poisson PML event study around common date
n_eligible_specs_note: One common treatment date; main estimator nonlinear.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: gpt3 switches on at the ChatGPT release for every high-exposure firm.
modern_estimator_note: jwdid (ETWFE) is reported as robustness but is not an admitted modern estimator (PROTOCOL 5b).

specs.exclusion_reason: single common adoption date; Poisson PML (nonlinear)
specs.outcome: y0, y1_a, y1_b, y2_a, y2_b, y2_c, y3_a, y3_b, y4_a, y4_b (skill-demand posting counts)
specs.controls: none (cols without controls) / size roa leverage rd_ta rd_d capex_at layoff_p

data_access: proprietary (Lightcast job postings via Snowflake, Revelio via WRDS, Compustat via WRDS); not shipped
data_provenance_note: Only code, output tables and logs are shipped; analysis data require licensed access.
software_notes: Stata 18 (ppmlhdfe, reghdfe, cem, honestdid, jwdid) driven by Python (pystata); SQL for data retrieval.
screener_notes: Screened from the package only (no article text); the abstract confirms the ChatGPT release as a single exogenous shock. No package code was run.
